0895-maximum-frequency-stack.note: Video uses a count map, maxCnt, and a hash map from frequency to stack; identical to Stack Of Stacks (Hash Map).

0901-online-stock-span.note: Video keeps a monotonic decreasing stack of (price, span) pairs and merges spans on pop; identical to approach 1.

0912-sort-an-array.note: Video implements recursive top-down merge sort with a merge helper, matching Merge Sort.

0918-maximum-sum-circular-subarray.note: Video runs Kadane for both global max and global min and returns max(globMax, total - globMin), identical to the Kadane's approach.

0953-verifying-an-alien-dictionary.note: Video compares each adjacent pair at the first differing character using an order index map, matching Comparing adjacent words.

0973-k-closest-points-to-origin.note: Video heapifies all (dist, x, y) tuples and pops k times; identical to the Min-Heap approach.

0978-longest-turbulent-subarray.note: Video uses l/r pointers with a prev sign string and resets the window on equal or repeated sign, identical to the sliding window approach.

0981-time-based-key-value-store.note: Video stores per-key lists of [value, timestamp] and binary searches the list in get; identical to Binary Search (Array).

0994-rotting-oranges.note: Video does level-order BFS from all rotten oranges with a fresh counter, identical to Breadth First Search.

0997-find-the-town-judge.note: Video uses a single delta counter (indegree minus outdegree) and checks n-1, matching Indegree & Outdegree (Optimal).

1011-capacity-to-ship-packages-within-d-.note: Video binary searches capacity in [max, sum] with a canShip feasibility check; same as Binary Search (article adds an early-exit in canShip).

1046-last-stone-weight.note: First solution in the file negates values into a min-heap as a max-heap; identical to the Heap approach (the _heapify_max version is a second solution).

1049-last-stone-weight-ii.note: Video uses dfs(i, total) with a (i,total) memo dict and target ceil(sum/2), matching Top-Down.

1143-longest-common-subsequence.note: Video uses a full 2D dp table filled from the bottom-right, matching Bottom-Up.

1448-count-good-nodes-in-binary-tree.note: Video does recursive DFS passing the running max down; identical to the DFS approach.

1584-min-cost-to-connect-all-points.note: Video builds a full adjacency list of Manhattan distances and runs heap-based Prim's with a visit set; identical to Prim's Algorithm.

1768-merge-strings-alternately.note: Video uses two pointers i/j in a while loop over both strings then appends the leftover slices, identical to Two Pointers - I.

1851-minimum-interval-to-include-each-qu.note: Video sorts intervals and queries, pushes (size, end) onto a min-heap and pops expired ones, identical to Min Heap.

1899-merge-triplets-to-form-target-tripl.note: Video skips triplets exceeding target and collects matching indices into a set of size 3, identical to the first greedy approach.

1929-concatenation-of-array.note: Video appends every element twice via an outer range(2) loop, matching the Two Pass iteration.

2013-detect-squares.note: Video stores a point-count map plus a list of points and checks diagonals, identical to Hash Map - I.

2402-meeting-rooms-iii.note: Video uses an available-rooms min-heap plus a used-rooms (end_time, room) min-heap, identical to Two Min-Heaps.
